# Vocabulary: technique_maturity

Deployment maturity of a technique in games specifically (not in general AI).

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `research` | Research | Papers and lab demos only. |
| `prototype` | Prototype | Public playable demos, jams, or tech previews; no sustained commercial title. |
| `shipped-niche` | Shipped (niche) | Used at runtime or in production by at least one commercial game, but not a genre norm. |
| `shipped-mainstream` | Shipped (mainstream) | Common in commercial pipelines or runtimes across studios. |
